source.mainFunction:
[엠에스엠] ① 관절 및 연골건강에 도움을 줄 수 있음 [아연] ① 정상적인 면역기능에 필요 ② 정상적인 세포분열에 필요 [비타민D] ① 칼슘과 인이 흡수되고 이용되는데 필요 ② 뼈의 형성과 유지에 필요 ③ 골다공증발생 위험 감소에 도움을 줌

[포스파티딜세린] ① 노화로 인해 저하된 인지력 개선 ･ 자외선에 의한 피부 손상으로부터 피부 건강 유지 ･ 피부보습에 도움을 줄 수 있음 [은행잎추출물] ① 기억력 개선 ･ 혈행 개선에 도움을 줄 수 있음 [비타민E] ① 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
source.baseStandard:

② 엠에스엠 : 표시량(1,500mg/3,000mg)의 80 ~ 120%
③ 아연 : 표시량(8.5mg/3,000mg)의 80 ~ 150%
④ 비타민 D : 표시량(10ug/3,000mg)의 80 ~ 180%

주식회사 상상바이오 제조 · 1일 2회 1정

이 제품은 MSM 1500mg, 비타민 D 10μg, 비타민 E 11mg, 아연 8.5mg, 은행잎추출물 28mg, 포스파티딜세린 300mg를 표시량으로 담은 6원료 복합 건강기능식품입니다. 각 원료의 공식 인정 기능성은 아래와 같습니다.

왜 이 제품인가

  • 1일 2회(1정) 섭취로 MSM 1500mg, 비타민 D 10μg, 비타민 E 11mg, 아연 8.5mg, 은행잎추출물 28mg, 포스파티딜세린 300mg
  • 대장균군 음성 — 식약처 신고 기준 적합
  • 정제 : 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 불규칙한 점박이를 포함한 밝은 회황색의 장방형 제피정제, 캡슐 : 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 회황색의 분말을 함유한 흰색의 경질캡슐 · 주식회사 상상바이오 제조

원료별 공식 인정 기능성

  • MSM
    • 관절 및 연골건강에 도움을 줄 수 있음
  • 비타민 D
    • 칼슘과 인이 흡수되고 이용되는데 필요
    • 뼈의 형성과 유지에 필요
    • 골다공증발생 위험 감소에 도움을 줌
  • 비타민 E
    • 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
  • 아연
    • 정상적인 면역기능에 필요
    • 정상적인 세포분열에 필요
  • 은행잎추출물
    • 기억력 개선 ･ 혈행 개선에 도움을 줄 수 있음
  • 포스파티딜세린
    • 노화로 인해 저하된 인지력 개선 ･ 자외선에 의한 피부 손상으로부터 피부 건강 유지 ･ 피부보습에 도움을 줄 수 있음

섭취방법 (공식 표기 그대로)

1일 2회1회 1정물과 함께

표시 기준

MSM 표시량(1500mg/3000mg)의 80~120%
비타민 D 표시량(10μg/3000mg)의 80~180%
비타민 E 표시량(11mg/3000mg)의 80~150%
아연 표시량(8.5mg/3000mg)의 80~150%
은행잎추출물 표시량(28mg/3000mg)의 80~120%
포스파티딜세린 표시량(300mg/3000mg)의 80~120%
성상 정제 : 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 불규칙한 점박이를 포함한 밝은 회황색의 장방형 제피정제, 캡슐 : 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 회황색의 분말을 함유한 흰색의 경질캡슐
대장균군 음성
유통기한 제조일로부터 24개월까지
보관 ① 직사광선 및 고온 다습한 곳을 피하여 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오. ② 개봉 후에는 공기의 노출을 최대한 차단하여 보관 하십시오. ③ 어린이의 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

이런 분께

  • 매일 MSM · 비타민 D · 비타민 E · 아연 · 은행잎추출물 · 포스파티딜세린 섭취를 함께 챙기고 싶은 분

  • 간편하게 여러 영양을 함께 관리하고 싶은 분

drafts.en:
Health Functional FoodMSM 1500mgVitamin D 10μgVitamin E 11mgZinc 8.5mgGinkgo leaf extract 28mgPhosphatidylserine 300mg2 times a day

나의 엄마,아빠 하나로 올인케어(My Mom, Dad All-in-care)MSM · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Zinc · Ginkgo leaf extract · Phosphatidylserine

Made by 주식회사 상상바이오 · 2 times a day · 1 capsule

This product combines 1500mg of MSM, 10μg of Vitamin D, 11mg of Vitamin E, 8.5mg of Zinc, 28mg of Ginkgo leaf extract, 300mg of Phosphatidylserine as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • 2 times a day (1 capsule): 1500mg MSM, 10μg Vitamin D, 11mg Vitamin E, 8.5mg Zinc, 28mg Ginkgo leaf extract, 300mg Phosphatidylserine
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 주식회사 상상바이오

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • MSM
    • May help with joint and cartilage health
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • May help protect cells from reactive oxygen species through antioxidant activity.
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Ginkgo leaf extract
    • May help improve memory, improve blood circulation.
  • Phosphatidylserine
    • May help improve cognitive function that declines with aging, maintain skin health from UV-induced skin damage, support skin moisturizing.

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

2 times a day1 capsule per servingWith water

Labelled standard

MSM labelled (1500mg / 3000mg), 80~120%
Vitamin D labelled (10μg / 3000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin E labelled (11mg / 3000mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 3000mg), 80~150%
Ginkgo leaf extract labelled (28mg / 3000mg), 80~120%
Phosphatidylserine labelled (300mg / 3000mg), 80~120%
Appearance 정제 : 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 불규칙한 점박이를 포함한 밝은 회황색의 장방형 제피정제, 캡슐 : 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 회황색의 분말을 함유한 흰색의 경질캡슐
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월까지
Storage ① 직사광선 및 고온 다습한 곳을 피하여 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오. ② 개봉 후에는 공기의 노출을 최대한 차단하여 보관 하십시오. ③ 어린이의 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take MSM · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Zinc · Ginkgo leaf extract · Phosphatidylserine together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a professional before use · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Keep out of reach of children · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

source.mainFunction:
1) 마리골드꽃추출물 : 노화로 인해 감소될 수 있는 황반색소밀도를 유지하여 눈 건강에 도움을 줄 수 있음
2) 헤마토코쿠스추출물 : 눈의 피로도 개선에 도움을 줄 수 있음
3) 비타민C : 결합조직 형성과 기능유지에 필요, 철의 흡수에 필요, 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
4) 비타민E : 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
5) 아연 : 정상적인 면역기능에 필요, 정상적인 세포분열에 필요
6) 구리 : 철의 운반과 이용에 필요, 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요

섭취 시 위장장애, 소화불량의 증상이 있을 경우 섭취를 중단하십시오.

섭취 전 제품에 이상이 있는 경우 섭취를 금하십시오.

과다 섭취 시 일시적으로 피부가 황색으로 변할 수 있습니다.

과량 섭취하지 않도록 주의하십시오.
신장질환이 있는 경우 섭취 전 전문가와 상담하십시오.

아이원 글라우테인 아스타잔틴Copper · Lutein · Vitamin E · Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin) · Zinc

Made by 주식회사 노바렉스2공장 · Once a day · 1 capsule

This product combines 1mg of Copper, 9.902mg of Lutein, 134mg of Vitamin E, 6mg of Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin), 12.5mg of Zinc as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 capsule): 1mg Copper, 9.902mg Lutein, 134mg Vitamin E, 6mg Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin), 12.5mg Zinc
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 주식회사 노바렉스2공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Copper
    • May help protect cells from reactive oxygen species through antioxidant activity.
    • Needed for the transport and utilisation of iron
  • Lutein
    • May help maintain macular pigment density that may decline with aging and support eye health.
  • Vitamin E
    • May help protect cells from reactive oxygen species through antioxidant activity.
  • Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin)
    • May help improve eye fatigue.
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 capsule per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Copper labelled (1mg / 740mg), 80~150%
Lutein labelled (9.902mg / 740mg), 80~120%
Vitamin E labelled (134mg / 740mg), 80~150%
Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin) labelled (6mg / 740mg), 80~120%
Zinc labelled (12.5mg / 740mg), 80~150%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미·이취가 없는 어두운 적갈색의 점도가 있는 내용물을 함유한 갈흑색의 장방형 연질캡슐
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 1. 고온다습한 곳과 직사광선을 피하여 습기가 적고 건조한 곳에 보관하십시오. 2. 개봉 후에는 공기의 노출을 최대한 차단하여 보관하십시오. 3. 영유아 및 어린이의 손에 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오. 4.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Copper · Lutein · Vitamin E · Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin) · Zinc together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a professional before use · Consult a professional if you have a condition or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Keep out of reach of children · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

  • 비타민 B12

  • 비타민 B6
    • 단백질 및 아미노산 이용에 필요
    • 혈액의 호모시스테인 수준을 정상으로 유지하는데 필요
  • 아연
    • 정상적인 면역기능에 필요
    • 정상적인 세포분열에 필요
  • 엽산
    • 혈액의 호모시스테인 수준을 정상으로 유지하는데 필요
    • 세포와 혈액생성에 필요
    • 태아 신경관의 정상 발달에 필요
  • 포스파티딜세린
    • 노화로 인해 저하된 인지력 개선·자외선에 의한 피부 손상으로부터 피부 건강 유지·피부보습에 도움을 줄 수 있음

섭취방법 (공식 표기 그대로)

1일 1회1회 2정물과 함께

나이아신 표시량(15mg/2000mg)의 80~150%
비타민 B12 표시량(2.4μg/2000mg)의 80~180%
비타민 B6 표시량(1.5mg/2000mg)의 80~150%
아연 표시량(8.5mg/2000mg)의 80~150%

Made by 주식회사 노바렉스 · Once a day · 2 tablets

This product combines 15mg of Niacin, 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 8.5mg of Zinc, 400μg of Folate, 300mg of Phosphatidylserine as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (2 tablets): 15mg Niacin, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 8.5mg Zinc, 400μg Folate, 300mg Phosphatidylserine
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 주식회사 노바렉스

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Phosphatidylserine
    • May help improve cognitive function that declines with aging, maintain skin health from UV-induced skin damage, support skin moisturizing.

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day2 tablets per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (15mg / 2000mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B12 labelled (2.4μg / 2000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.5mg / 2000mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 2000mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (400μg / 2000mg), 80~150%
Phosphatidylserine labelled (300mg / 2000mg), 80~120%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미·이취가 없는 점박이를 포함한 흰 노란색의 투명 장방형 제피 정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 1. 고온다습한 곳과 직사광선을 피하여 습기가 적고 건조한 곳에 보관하십시오. 2. 개봉 후에는 공기의 노출을 최대한 차단하여 보관하십시오. 3. 영유아 및 어린이의 손에 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B6 · Zinc · Folate · Phosphatidylserine together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a professional before use · Consult a professional if you have a condition or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

Health Functional FoodLutein 20mgVitamin A 700μgVitamin C 30mgVitamin E 11mgHaematococcus extract (astaxanthin) 6mgZinc 8.5mgOnce a day

아이클리어 루테인아스타잔틴Lutein · Vitamin A · Vitamin C · Vitamin E · Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin) · Zinc

Made by (주)서흥 · Once a day · 1 capsule

This product combines 20mg of Lutein, 700μg of Vitamin A, 30mg of Vitamin C, 11mg of Vitamin E, 6mg of Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin), 8.5mg of Zinc as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 capsule): 20mg Lutein, 700μg Vitamin A, 30mg Vitamin C, 11mg Vitamin E, 6mg Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin), 8.5mg Zinc
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)서흥

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Lutein
    • May help maintain macular pigment density that may decline with aging and support eye health.
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • May help protect cells from reactive oxygen species through antioxidant activity.
  • Vitamin E
    • May help protect cells from reactive oxygen species through antioxidant activity.
  • Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin)
    • May help improve eye fatigue.
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 capsule per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Lutein labelled (20mg / 0.4g), 80~120%
Vitamin A labelled (700μg / 0.4g), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (30mg / 0.4g), 80~150%
Vitamin E labelled (11mg / 0.4g), 80~150%
Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin) labelled (6mg / 0.4g), 80~120%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 0.4g), 80~150%

Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일부터 24개월
Storage ① 제품은 직사광선을 피해 실온에서 보관 유통하십시오. ② 어린이의 손에 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Lutein · Vitamin A · Vitamin C · Vitamin E · Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin) · Zinc together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a professional before use · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Keep out of reach of children · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

  • 1일 1회(1캡슐) 섭취로 루테인 20mg, 비타민 A 700μg, 비타민 C 30mg, 비타민 E 11mg, 헤마토코쿠스추출물(아스타잔틴) 6mg, 아연 8.5mg

  • 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없으며 진한 적갈색의 내용물을 함유한 적갈색의 타원형 연질캡슐 · (주)알피바이오 제조

  • 비타민 A
    • 어두운 곳에서 시각 적응을 위해 필요
    • 피부와 점막을 형성하고 기능을 유지하는데 필요
    • 상피세포의 성장과 발달에 필요
  • 비타민 C
    • 결합조직 형성과 기능유지에 필요
    • 철의 흡수에 필요
    • 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
  • 비타민 E
    • 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
  • 헤마토코쿠스추출물(아스타잔틴)
    • 눈의 피로도 개선에 도움을 줄 수 있음
  • 아연
    • 정상적인 면역기능에 필요
    • 정상적인 세포분열에 필요

섭취방법 (공식 표기 그대로)

1일 1회1회 1캡슐물과 함께

루테인 표시량(20mg/400mg)의 80~120%
비타민 A 표시량(700μg/400mg)의 80~150%
비타민 C 표시량(30mg/400mg)의 80~150%
비타민 E 표시량(11mg/400mg)의 80~150%
헤마토코쿠스추출물(아스타잔틴) 표시량(6mg/400mg)의 80~120%

  • 매일 루테인 · 비타민 A · 비타민 C · 비타민 E · 헤마토코쿠스추출물(아스타잔틴) · 아연 섭취를 함께 챙기고 싶은 분

Health Functional FoodLutein 20mgVitamin A 700μgVitamin C 30mgVitamin E 11mgHaematococcus extract (astaxanthin) 6mgZinc 8.5mgOnce a day

아이클리어 루테인아스타잔틴Lutein · Vitamin A · Vitamin C · Vitamin E · Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin) · Zinc

Made by (주)알피바이오 · Once a day · 1 capsule

This product combines 20mg of Lutein, 700μg of Vitamin A, 30mg of Vitamin C, 11mg of Vitamin E, 6mg of Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin), 8.5mg of Zinc as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 capsule): 20mg Lutein, 700μg Vitamin A, 30mg Vitamin C, 11mg Vitamin E, 6mg Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin), 8.5mg Zinc
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)알피바이오

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Lutein
    • May help maintain macular pigment density that may decline with aging and support eye health.
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • May help protect cells from reactive oxygen species through antioxidant activity.
  • Vitamin E
    • May help protect cells from reactive oxygen species through antioxidant activity.
  • Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin)
    • May help improve eye fatigue.
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 capsule per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Lutein labelled (20mg / 400mg), 80~120%
Vitamin A labelled (700μg / 400mg), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (30mg / 400mg), 80~150%
Vitamin E labelled (11mg / 400mg), 80~150%
Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin) labelled (6mg / 400mg), 80~120%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 400mg), 80~150%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없으며 진한 적갈색의 내용물을 함유한 적갈색의 타원형 연질캡슐
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 24개월
Storage 직사광선과 고온다습한 곳을 피하여 습기가 적고 건조한 곳에 보관하십시오. 어린이의 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Lutein · Vitamin A · Vitamin C · Vitamin E · Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin) · Zinc together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a professional before use · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Keep out of reach of children · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

눈피로엔 루테인아스타잔틴Lutein · Vitamin A · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin) · Zinc

Made by 주식회사 노바렉스2공장 · Once a day · 1 capsule

This product combines 20mg of Lutein, 0.42mg of Vitamin A, 10μg of Vitamin D, 11mg of Vitamin E, 6mg of Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin), 2.55mg of Zinc as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 capsule): 20mg Lutein, 0.42mg Vitamin A, 10μg Vitamin D, 11mg Vitamin E, 6mg Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin), 2.55mg Zinc
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 주식회사 노바렉스2공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Lutein
    • May help maintain macular pigment density that may decline with aging and support eye health.
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • May help protect cells from reactive oxygen species through antioxidant activity.
  • Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin)
    • May help improve eye fatigue.
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 capsule per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Lutein labelled (20mg / 500mg), 80~120%
Vitamin A labelled (0.42mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (10μg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin E labelled (11mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin) labelled (6mg / 500mg), 80~120%
Zinc labelled (2.55mg / 500mg), 80~150%

Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 1) 고온다습한 곳과 직사광선을 피하여 습기가 적고 건조한 곳에 보관하십시오. 2) 개봉 후에는 공기의 노출을 최대한 차단하여 보관 하십시오. 3) 영유아 및 어린이의 손에 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Lutein · Vitamin A · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin) · Zinc together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a professional before use · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Keep out of reach of children · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

Made by 코스맥스바이오(주) · Once a day · 1 capsule

This product combines 20mg of Lutein, 700μg of Vitamin A, 10μg of Vitamin D, 11mg of Vitamin E, 4mg of Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin), 8.5mg of Zinc as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 capsule): 20mg Lutein, 700μg Vitamin A, 10μg Vitamin D, 11mg Vitamin E, 4mg Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin), 8.5mg Zinc
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 코스맥스바이오(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Lutein
    • May help maintain macular pigment density that may decline with aging and support eye health.
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • May help protect cells from reactive oxygen species through antioxidant activity.
  • Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin)
    • May help improve eye fatigue.
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 capsule per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Lutein labelled (20mg / 500mg), 80~120%
Vitamin A labelled (700μg / 500mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (10μg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin E labelled (11mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin) labelled (4mg / 500mg), 80~120%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 500mg), 80~150%

Coliform Negative

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Lutein · Vitamin A · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin) · Zinc together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients

Health Functional FoodLutein 20mgVitamin A 210μgVitamin D 25μgVitamin E 3.3mgHaematococcus extract (astaxanthin) 8mgOmega-3 1000mg2 times a day

미건 rTG 메가테인Lutein · Vitamin A · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin) · Omega-3

Made by (주)알피바이오 · 2 times a day · 1 capsule

This product combines 20mg of Lutein, 210μg of Vitamin A, 25μg of Vitamin D, 3.3mg of Vitamin E, 8mg of Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin), 1000mg of Omega-3 as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • 2 times a day (1 capsule): 20mg Lutein, 210μg Vitamin A, 25μg Vitamin D, 3.3mg Vitamin E, 8mg Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin), 1000mg Omega-3
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)알피바이오

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Lutein
    • May help maintain macular pigment density that may decline with aging and support eye health.
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • May help protect cells from reactive oxygen species through antioxidant activity.
  • Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin)
    • May help improve eye fatigue.
  • Omega-3
    • May help improve blood triglycerides, improve blood circulation, improve memory, improve dry eyes and support eye health.

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

2 times a day1 capsule per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Lutein labelled (20mg / 1800mg), 80~120%
Vitamin A labelled (210μg / 1800mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (25μg / 1800mg), 80~180%
Vitamin E labelled (3.3mg / 1800mg), 80~150%
Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin) labelled (8mg / 1800mg), 80~120%
Omega-3 labelled (1000mg / 1800mg), 80~120%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 적갈색의 내용물을 함유한 어두운 빨간색의 장방형 연질캡슐
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 실온 / 직사광선과 고온다습한 곳을 피하여 습기가 적고 건조한 곳에 보관하십시오. 어린이의 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Lutein · Vitamin A · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin) · Omega-3 together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a professional before use · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Keep out of reach of children · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

  • Lutein

  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • May help protect cells from reactive oxygen species through antioxidant activity.
  • Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin)
    • May help improve eye fatigue.
  • Omega-3
    • May help improve blood triglycerides.
    • May help improve blood circulation.
    • May help improve memory.
    • May help improve dry eyes and support eye health.

This product combines 20mg of Lutein, 700μg of Vitamin A, 25μg of Vitamin D, 3.3mg of Vitamin E, 6mg of Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin), 600mg of Omega-3 as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Lutein
    • May help maintain macular pigment density that may decline with aging and support eye health.
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • May help protect cells from reactive oxygen species through antioxidant activity.
  • Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin)
    • May help improve eye fatigue.
  • Omega-3
    • May help improve blood triglycerides, improve blood circulation, improve dry eyes and support eye health.

Once a day2 capsules per servingWith water

Made by (주)유유헬스케어 · Once a day · 1 capsule

This product combines 20mg of Lutein, 700μg of Vitamin A, 11mg of Vitamin E, 16.5μg of Selenium, 4mg of Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin), 8.5mg of Zinc as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

  • Made by (주)유유헬스케어

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Lutein
    • May help maintain macular pigment density that may decline with aging and support eye health.
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin E
    • May help protect cells from reactive oxygen species through antioxidant activity.
  • Selenium
    • May help protect cells from reactive oxygen species through antioxidant activity.
  • Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin)
    • May help improve eye fatigue.
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division

Once a day1 capsule per servingWith water

Lutein labelled (20mg / 420mg), 80~120%
Vitamin A labelled (700μg / 420mg), 80~150%
Vitamin E labelled (11mg / 420mg), 80~150%
Selenium labelled (16.5μg / 420mg), 80~150%
Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin) labelled (4mg / 420mg), 80~120%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 420mg), 80~150%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 진한 빨강색의 내용물을 함유한 흑갈색의 타원형 연질캡슐
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월까지
Storage 직사광선 및 고온다습한 곳을 피해 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Lutein · Vitamin A · Vitamin E · Selenium · Haematococcus extract (astaxanthin) · Zinc together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a professional before use · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Keep out of reach of children · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
